nodes.name: API.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive REST API reference for labConnect covering all 71 endpoints across authentication, biometrics, laboratories, personnel, test catalog, samples, inventory, orders/results, and appointments — including role-based access rules and 2FA requirements.
nodes.languageNotes: Written primarily in French with mixed French/English technical terms; covers JWT auth flows, TOTP/biometric 2FA, and CNAM reimbursement workflows.

nodes.name: totp.py
nodes.summary: TOTP 2FA service implementing RFC 6238 using pyotp, providing secret generation, code verification with ±1 window tolerance, provisioning URI construction, and base64 QR code generation for authenticator app enrollment.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pyotp and qrcode libraries; QR output is base64-encoded PNG suitable for direct embedding in React Native Image components.

nodes.name: generate_secret
nodes.summary: Generates a cryptographically secure 32-character base32 TOTP secret using pyotp.

nodes.name: verify_code
nodes.summary: Verifies a TOTP code against a secret with ±1 step clock-drift tolerance, returning a boolean result.

nodes.name: provisioning_uri
nodes.summary: Builds the otpauth:// provisioning URI used by authenticator apps to register a TOTP account, including app name and phone as issuer/account.

nodes.name: qr_code_base64
nodes.summary: Generates a base64-encoded PNG QR code from the TOTP provisioning URI, ready for embedding in mobile app image components.
